title: 第3章 他还得谢谢咱呢，见上司
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李万顺叫下属去给许景川办了入职手续，并当场制作了警官证。

又带他去领了警服、警枪等。

然后打了个电话到西城警署。

“伊芙琳署长，上头给你们补了个刑事组队长，安排人来领一下。”

“什么来头啊老李？一个小小的警署队长还值得上面专门派人吗？”

“我只知道他拿着州警察厅任命书来报道的，王局亲自做的安排。”

“法克！不会又是个少爷吧？”

“这可是员干将，你们辖区冒充警察入室抢劫的凶手在路上跟他撞上了，两死一逃，警服警枪都已经追回来了，要我说你就偷着乐吧。”

“还真有点本事，但也他妈是给我添麻烦，唉，我马上派人来。”

李万顺挂断电话抬起头对许景川说道：“这个队长的位置可有不少人都盯着，我给你要来了，但能不能坐稳就看你自己的本事了。”

“多谢李科关照，我一定不让您失望。”许景川上前给他续了杯茶。

这钱当真是没白花。

李万顺端起茶杯抿了一口，语气悠悠说道：“还有什么要问的没有？”

“李科，我头一次当警察，对咱们这行不太了解，独在异乡也没个能商量的人，我看见您的第一眼就觉得亲切，今后还可否登门请教？”

许景川一脸单纯的询问。

李万顺放下茶杯，斜眼审视着他笑呵呵的道：“你这是要赖上我啊？”

“哪能呢，这不是瞧您亲切嘛。”

“行，那我就当关照关照后辈。”

“诶，多谢李叔。”许景川立刻改了称呼，又上前续水，“叔，喝茶。”

“你小子，有前途。”

“那也是您老给的前途。”

“赃款的事……”

“什么赃款？叔，赃款在逃走的匪首身上，是我没用，没能追回。”

“咳，倒也不必自责，以一敌三能手刃两贼追回警械就很不错了。”

两人你一言我一语越说越投机。

从纪元后的世界新格局。

聊到什么肤色的女人润。

当真有种相见恨晚的感觉。

“报告！”

一道声音突然在门口响起。

李万顺意犹未尽的说道：“进。”

一个身材略胖、个头高大，相貌憨厚中又带着点猥琐的中级警员走了进来，“李科，我是西城警署刑事组三队警员胡天，奉命来接队长。”

许景川看见他后嘴角一抽。

“这位就是你们的新队长，许景川警长。”李万顺指着许景川介绍。

胡天立刻敬礼，“队长好。”

“你好。”许景川回了一礼。

李万顺说道：“去吧，对了，赃车和那两具尸体一起带走，本来就是该你们西城警署负责的案子。”

“是！那李叔，我先走了。”许景川点点头，敬了一礼后转身离去。

胡天连忙跟上。

出了办公室后，胡天就立刻伸手去抢许景川手上拎的东西，“恩公，我来提吧。”

“这恩公之称从何说起呢？”许景川顺手将东西递给他，疑惑的问道。

“哎，死鱼滴尾巴，不摆了。”胡天露出个憋屈的表情，表示不想提。

许景川笑笑，“说说看嘛。”

“说来话长，您打死那两个罪犯身上的警服和枪就是从我跟我搭档那里抢的。”胡天说起此事咬牙切齿。

又马上补充一句：“当然，他们当时是从背后偷袭，要正面交手的话绝对是厕所里面打灯笼，找死！”

“原来如此，这么说来我是帮你报了仇。”许景川恍然大悟的点头。

胡天满脸感激的连连点头，“是啊是啊，所以说当得起一声恩公。”

“还是叫我队长吧，习惯点。”

“是，队长。”

来到车旁，许景川

“当时他们蒙着脸。”胡天看了几眼说道：“不过警服是我的，身形也对得上，是了，肯定是他们没错！”

许景川把两支警枪递过去，“看看哪把是你的，你搭档的转交下。”

“谢谢队长，你这回真是帮了我大忙，不然枪找不回来的话我麻烦可就大了。”胡天感激涕零的接过枪。

瞧，他还得谢谢咱呢。

Page (1/3)

Li Wanshun asked his subordinates to go through the entry procedures for Xu Jingchuan and made a police officer certificate on the spot.

They also took him to collect police uniforms, police guns, etc.

Then I made a call to the Xicheng Police Station.

"Director Evelin, the higher ups have appointed a criminal team captain for you and arranged for someone to come and collect it."

"What's your background, Lao Li? Is a small police station captain worthy of sending special personnel from above?"

"I only know that he came to report with the appointment letter from the State Police Department, and Director Wang personally made the arrangements."

"Fake! He's not a young master again, is he?"

"This is a police officer. The murderer in your jurisdiction who pretended to be a police officer to break into a house ran into him on the road. Two died and one escaped. The police uniforms and guns have been recovered. If you ask me, you can just have fun."

"You're really capable, but you're just causing trouble for me. Oh, I'll send someone right away."

Li Wanshun hung up the phone and raised his head and said to Xu Jingchuan: "Many people are eyeing this position of captain. I'm here for you, but whether you can sit still depends on your own ability."

"Thank you Li Ke for taking care of me. I will not let you down." Xu Jingchuan stepped forward and refilled his cup of tea.

This money is really not in vain.

Li Wanshun picked up the tea cup and took a sip, and said in a leisurely tone: "Is there anything else you want to ask?"

"Li Ke, this is my first time as a police officer. I don't know much about our industry. I am alone in a foreign land and there is no one I can talk to. I felt friendly at the first sight when I saw you. Can you come and ask for advice in the future?"

Xu Jingchuan asked innocently.

Li Wanshun put down the teacup, looked at him sideways and said with a smile: "Are you relying on me?"

"How can I? Isn't this just a sign of your kindness?"

"Okay, then I will take care of the younger generation."

"Hey, thank you very much, Uncle Li." Xu Jingchuan immediately changed his title and stepped forward to refill the water, "Uncle, drink tea."

"You boy, you have a future."

"That's the future you always gave me."

"The matter of stolen money..."

"What kind of stolen money? Uncle, the stolen money is on the escaped bandit leader. I am useless and cannot recover it."

"Ahem, there's no need to blame yourself. It would be great to recover the police equipment by killing two thieves with one enemy and three capable hands."

The two of them talked more and more together.

The new pattern of the world after the epoch.

Let’s talk about what skin color women have.

It really feels like we met too late.

"Report!"

A voice suddenly sounded at the door.

Li Wanshun said without hesitation: "Come in."

A slightly fat, tall, mid-level police officer with a simple and honest appearance walked in, "Li Ke, I am Hu Tian, a police officer from the third team of the Xicheng Police Department's criminal team, and I have been ordered to pick up the captain."

Xu Jingchuan's mouth twitched when he saw him.

"This is your new captain, Sheriff Xu Jingchuan." Li Wanshun pointed at Xu Jingchuan and introduced.

Hu Tian immediately saluted, "Hello, captain."

"Hello." Xu Jingchuan returned the greeting.

Li Wanshun said: "Go ahead. By the way, the stolen car and the two corpses were taken away together. This is a case that your Xicheng Police Department should be responsible for."

"Yes! Then Uncle Li, I'll leave first." Xu Jingchuan nodded, saluted and turned to leave.

Hu Tian quickly followed.

After leaving the office, Hu Tian immediately reached out to grab what Xu Jingchuan was carrying, "My dear friend, let me carry it."

"Where does this title of benefactor come from?" Xu Jingchuan handed him the thing smoothly and asked doubtfully.

"Hey, it's a dead fish with a tail, so I won't swing it anymore." Hu Tian showed an aggrieved expression, saying that he didn't want to mention it.

Xu Jingchuan smiled and said, "Let's talk about it."

"It's a long story. The police uniforms and guns you killed the two criminals were stolen from my partner and I." Hu Tian gritted his teeth when talking about this.

Then he immediately added: "Of course, they attacked from behind. If they had to fight head-on, they would definitely set up a lantern in the toilet, seeking death!"

"I see. In this way, I helped you get revenge." Xu Jingchuan nodded in realization.

Hu Tian nodded with gratitude, "Yes, yes, so I deserve a benefactor."

"Just call me captain, get used to it."

"Yes, Captain."

Arriving at the car, Xu Jingchuan

"They were covering their faces at the time." Hu Tian took a few glances and said, "But the police uniform belongs to me, and my body shape matches it. Yes, it must be them!"

Xu Jingchuan handed over the two police guns, "See which one is yours, and pass it on to your partner."

"Thank you, captain. You really helped me a lot this time. Otherwise, I would be in big trouble if I couldn't find the gun." Hu Tian took the gun with tears in his eyes.

Look, he still has to thank us.
